description: Cropped screenshot of the Twitter trending sidebar showing the hashtag topic Obamagate trending at No. 11 under Politics with 3.43M tweets. Circulated around May 2020 when the Obamagate hashtag surged.

Side-by-side black-and-white youth photographs of two U.S. presidents. Left: Donald Trump at about age 20 in his New York Military Academy cadet uniform. Right: Barack Obama at about age 18 wearing a straw hat with a cigarette in his mouth, from a 1980 Occidental College-era photo session by Lisa Jack. Captions label them D. Trump, 20 and B. Obama, 18.

Black-and-white group photograph of military-school cadets in dress uniforms with white peaked caps, sashes and sergeant stripes, standing in formation rows. A sidebar credit reads New York Military Academy and a CNN watermark sits at lower right. The front-center cadet with cross-belt and sash is consistent with the widely published New York Military Academy yearbook photo of a young Donald Trump (mid-1960s).
flags: Central cadet identified as young Donald Trump from the widely published NYMA yearbook photo, not from a caption in the image; other cadets are private individuals and remain unidentified
